text: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizens with valid passport, in good physical and mental health, born before September 1, 2008. 2. Hold a senior high school diploma with excellent academic performance. 3. Chinese proficiency at HSK Level 4 (minimum score 180). 4. Meet the requirements of Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the Peoples Republic of China. 5. CSCA subjects requirements download here .
